title: Interview Platform — Overview
description: Live interviews, voice-loop latency SLOs, API and edge health.

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: UP when Prometheus scraped the target in the last interval. postgres/redis reflect their exporters.

panels.title: Model endpoints
panels.description: Shared vLLM servers (read-only). Whisper exposes no metrics; see the AI Models dashboard.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Interview sessions currently live across API processes.

panels.title: Open WebSockets
panels.description: Open realtime connections (candidate rooms).

panels.title: Turn latency p95
panels.description: Last 5 minutes: candidate end-of-turn to first interviewer audio. SLO: p95 < 3 s.

panels.title: First audio p95
panels.description: Last 5 minutes: interviewer utterance start to first TTS chunk sent. SLO: p95 < 2 s.

panels.title: API 5xx (5m)
panels.description: Share of API responses with status 5xx. Alert above 5%.

panels.title: Barge-ins (1h)
panels.description: Candidate interruptions of interviewer speech in the last hour.

panels.title: Turn latency: candidate end-of-turn to first interviewer audio
panels.description: Dashed line: 3 s SLO (alert TurnLatencyP95High).

panels.title: Time to first audio: utterance start to first TTS chunk
panels.description: Dashed line: 2 s SLO (alert TimeToFirstAudioP95High).

panels.title: Voice to voice: what the candidate hears
Voice to voice p90 (15m)
panels.description: Candidate's last word to the first audio of the interviewer's reply, last 15 minutes. Alert VoiceToVoiceSlow above 6 s.

panels.title: First sound p90 (15m)
panels.description: Candidate's last word to the first thing they hear: "Okay.", "One moment." or the reply. Above 5 s the "One moment." filler is not covering slow replies.

panels.title: Voice to voice: candidate's last word to the reply's first audio
panels.description: interview_voice_to_voice_seconds{reply="question"}: endpoint silence + transcription + decision + first speech chunk, server side (the browser adds ~150 ms). Dashed line: 6 s (alert VoiceToVoiceSlow, p90 over 15 minutes). Typed answers are not counted.

panels.title: First sound: "Okay.", "One moment." or the reply, whichever comes first
panels.description: interview_voice_to_voice_seconds{reply="first_sound"}: how long the candidate hears nothing after their last word. The turn.latency interview event says which sound came first.

panels.title: Turn stages (median): where a spoken turn's time goes
panels.description: interview_turn_stage_seconds: endpoint_silence (last word to end-of-turn decision), stt_final, commit_wait, decision_to_text (engine and model to the first speech chunk), tts_first_chunk, send. Medians do not add up exactly to the voice-to-voice median.

panels.title: Interviewer turn decisions by outcome per minute
panels.description: complete: the model's full decision; tail_cut: the reply was spoken but the decision after it was cut off; synthesized: the platform filled in a missing decision; fallback: a question-bank line because the model failed.

panels.title: Premature end of turn and "I already told you" per hour
panels.description: turn resumed: the candidate kept speaking after the end of their turn was decided (endpointing too eager). repeat complaint: the candidate said they had already answered (the interviewer asked the same thing again).

panels.title: Answer-evaluator contradictions per hour: kept or dropped by grounding
panels.description: Inconsistencies the answer evaluator proposed; dropped ones were not supported by the candidate's own words.

panels.title: Barge-ins per minute
panels.description: Candidate speech that interrupted the interviewer (handled by the runtime).

panels.title: Integrity events per minute by source
panels.description: Signals for human review only (never automatic decisions).

panels.title: Unexpected errors by component (selected range)
panels.description: interview_errors_total: unexpected exceptions caught per component.

panels.title: Edge requests by status class
panels.description: Every request through Caddy (SPA, API, WebSocket upgrades). 502 = API unreachable.
